input.quote: Contractor hereby grants to Company a royalty-free, non- exclusive perpetual license (including the right to grant a sublicense) to use, copy, modify, create, derivative version, publicly perform and publicly display such Contractor's Information in connection with Company's business operations.
input.rationale: Section 4(c) is the only licence granted to us (Contractor's background "Contractor's Information" embedded in the Works). It is royalty-free, non-exclusive, perpetual and sublicensable, which is partially compliant, but it falls short of the preferred position in three respects: (1) the licensee is only "Company", so Clear Capital's Affiliates and contractors acting on our behalf are not named; (2) the licence is perpetual but not stated to be irrevocable, leaving room for Contractor to assert a right to revoke; and (3) it is silent on transfer, while Section 10 (Nonassignability) bars assignment or transfer of the Agreement without consent, which puts continuity of the licence at risk in an M&A transaction. The redline adds Affiliates and contractors (with a control-based definition, as "Affiliates" is undefined in the document), adds "irrevocable", and carves the licence out of Section 10 for transfer to a successor. This is not a walk-away issue since the licence is not expressly revocable at Contractor's discretion.

proposal.summary: Extend the background-IP licence to Company's Affiliates and contractors, make it irrevocable, and permit transfer to a successor.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We extended the licence to Company's Affiliates and to contractors acting on our behalf, confirmed it is irrevocable as well as perpetual, and made it transferable to a successor in a merger or acquisition, since our Affiliates and outsourced personnel operate the delivered software and the licence should survive a corporate transaction. If helpful, we can accept Affiliate coverage on written notice as a fallback.

ops.oldText: Contractor hereby grants to Company a royalty-free, non- exclusive perpetual license (including the right to grant a sublicense) to use, copy, modify, create, derivative version, publicly perform and publicly display such Contractor's Information in connection with Company's business operations.
ops.newText: Contractor hereby grants to Company, its Affiliates (meaning any entity that controls, is controlled by, or is under common control with Company) and its contractors acting on Company's behalf a royalty-free, non- exclusive, perpetual and irrevocable license (including the right to grant a sublicense) to use, copy, modify, create, derivative version, publicly perform and publicly display such Contractor's Information in connection with the business operations of Company and its Affiliates. Notwithstanding Section 10 (Nonassignability), this license is transferable, without Contractor's consent, to any successor to Company's business or assets by merger, acquisition, reorganization or sale of assets.
